record.question: The minimum number of rows and columns in MS Word document is
record.explanation: A Word table can be as small as one row and one column, so the minimum row and column count is 1 and 1 (option A). The stem on PDF page 5 is worded loosely (it does not say 'table'), so the answer rests on the usual table interpretation.
